en: Y-You're right!
Hm? Really?

Your experience isn't any better just
because you predicted the ending.

Th-That's right.
It's fine if you don't figure it out!

Huh? Are you making me out
to be the bad guy?

Not really. I'm just saying there's
more than one way to watch a movie.

Either way, though, you shouldn't
stay up so late.

But doesn't staying up late at night
kinda make things more fun?
Oh, I get that.

I bet I wouldn't have even watched the
movie if it was on during the day.
Yeah, totally.
Don't you think so, Mama?
But staying up late...
Is it bad if you stay up late?

Well, they say late nights
are bad for the skin.
Oh, I've heard of that before.
See!
Hey, let me finish what I was saying.
That's what they say.

It's supposedly because your
hormones become unbalanced.
Hormones?

Yep. It puts you at higher risk of getting
dark spots on your skin. I saw it on TV.

It might be hormones but that
doesn't sound very realistic.
Sounds almost like a different world.

You say that, but that stuff
goes on in your own body.

So, don't you think it's
better to get to bed early?
Yeah, I agree.
There ya go.
What, why do you think that?
I dunno, I just do...

Don't be so nonchalant just because
it's not your skin at risk.
Hm? Seriously?

I remember this drugstore owner saying his
skin became smooth from sleeping early.

Really?
Then I better close the bar and sleep!
Hey hey, don't say that, I just got here...

Mama, you're beautiful even if
your skin isn't!
That doesn't make me feel better at all!

But sleeping earlier does
sound better for the body.

Wait a sec, weren't you saying
you're a late-night person?

Well you know how junk
food is really delicious?
Sure, it's delicious.

Anything fun or tasty is bad for your
health. That's how I look at it anyway.
So fun late nights are bad for your skin.

If that's true, then what about fun
late nights at the bar? Are they bad?
Yeah, they are.

Quiet, Kiryu-san, don't kill my business!
Are you trying to get me to close my bar?

If this place was gone,
we'd be in trouble too...
I should apologize...
They say laughter is the best medicine.

Sometimes enjoying something
enough can get rid of any harm.
Whaaat? Kiryu-san, you're so insightful!
I was gonna say the same thing as him!
Hm? Is that not good?
Well, it's pretty extreme logic.

I'd rather have bad skin than not
be able to come here anymore.
No one cares about your skin anyway.
Okay okay! Don't worry, guys!

If we all care about our health so much,
I'll turn this into a super healthy bar!
Super healthy? How?

First, I'll serve only vegetables and
alcohol with medicinal herbs in it.

And then I'll make it so that you
can't smoke in the store, and...
Wait, wait, Mama!
Wouldn't that be hard for you, Mama?

You have a point.
Actually, it'll be impossible.

There's nothing wrong
with keeping it as is.

He's right, you'd get so stressed that
your skin would be even worse.
Well, then there's no point in that.

Wait, did you just say my skin
would be "even worse?"
N-No, slip of the tongue...

Anyhow, let's focus on how great it
is that the bar isn't changing!
Then I'll continue business as usual!
No objections!
What's got ya so down?
Apparently something precious was stolen from him.
Huh? A robbery?
Precious to a chef, huh? A knife or somethin'?
They can have my knives. I buy 'em online.
Y'oughta be more careful all the same...
Then what got stolen?
Truth is...
My little girl might have herself a boyfriend!
Huh...? Weren't we talking about theft?
Oh it's theft alright! A man stole my daughter, y'know?
Ahhh, that's what you meant.
How old is your daughter?
High schoolers can't fall in love, c'mon...
Y'serious? High school is the peak of love.
Ah, guess that's true.
Young love reminds me of my school days!
Were ya pretty popular back then?
'Course I was! Well...
I liked this guy, Tanaka-kun, but he never noticed me.
If he'd loved me, I'd have been all set for life.
Damn, that's kinda bittersweet.
In war, y'gotta take down the enemy. Love's no different.
H-Hey, this ain't about Mama. Can we get back t'my problems?
Y'mean your daughter havin' a boyfriend?
Hey, I can't even say fer sure!
Let's go back to Mama's crazy love stories, then.
It wasn't crazy.
Hey, y'gone mute on us now, Kiryu-san?
We're all listening to you, Hatakeyama-san.
Kiryu-san... Thanks!
Fine, fine.
Wait, am I boring Kiryu-san over here?
S-Sorry I dozed off for a bit.
Sheesh, fine.
So, the boyfriend thing, whatchya gonna do about it?
How'd ya even find out she has one?
I overheard her talkin' to the missus this mornin'.
She'd probly hate me if I asked about it though...
Y'are at that age.
Daughters do get married, y'know. Ain't this kinda melodramatic?
I-It's too soon! I want my little girl a little longer...
I mean, say her boyfriend's some juvenile womanizer.
I'd strangle him.
But, what if he's a fine young man after all?
I s'pose he'd get to live.
People let this guy near sharp objects?
If I had a daughter, I'd worry about her datin' too.
Maybe y'oughta try askin' yer wife?
She's in cahoots with my wife. Won't tell me shit.
Fathers are powerless in these things.
What can ya do then?
Did you get any info on the guy that might help?
Ah, he's right, Hatakeyama-san.
Hm? What's wrong, Kiryu-san?
S-Sorry, my mind was wandering off...
Put some thought into this. He's got troubles, alright.
D'ya have any other info?
Info, huh...? Ugh.
Oh, that's definitely a "yes."
...She's about to go on a "date."
Oh-ho, a date, eh?
Where'd they even go 'round here? La Pente?
That's a classic spot.
Maybe y'oughta check?
Could be he's just a friend.
Spying on my daughter would be a new low...
Says the guy who eavesdropped on her already.
I dunno, I'd really lose it if he's some young punk...
You're dealing with a lot of emotions...
Be a man of action. It's time to head over, Hatakeyama-san.
Nothin' wrong with jus' scopin' it out a bit.
Besides, ya couldn't cook a single oyster like this.
Hmm, all right. I'll see if I can get an eye on her.
Thanks fer hearin' me out, fellas!
Don't you dare kill him, though.
I-I know that.
Hahaha!
Hmm... Maybe I shouldn't do this...
She'd hate me even more if she caught me...
Well, we won't force ya to...
I'll think about it. Thanks for this, fellas.
Keep it together.
That didn't really go anywhere...
What were you like as a kid, Mama?
Huh? That came out of nowhere.
I used to dream of becoming a singer when I was a little girl.
Oh, niiice. A singer, huh? That's so you.
Riiight? I'd always imagine standing under that spotlight.
I was sooo into stuff like that. I was meant for it, y'know?
If that's true, what are you doing at a place like this?
Place like this...?
I mean, I wish I could've pursued it.
But I was too scared to audition... since I'm shy, y'know?
What'd you guys have a meeting about how to respond?
That was a natural response, no meeting required.
I've never thought of you as shy.
Yeah, my first thought of you is...
That you're bold and full of energy, right?
That's kinda why I come to this bar; you're fun to talk to.
You guys are gonna make me cry.
Okay, let's move on...
After all that praise...?
Huh? What did you say?
Sorry, I was thinking about something else...
Sheesh, I can't understand you sometimes.
Whatever. So, why ask about my childhood?
The thing is, I have a class reunion in a bit.
So I was curious about everyone else's childhoods.
Oh, that's what this was about.
I've never been to a class reunion. Have a good time.
You should head on over there. Stop wasting time here!
I still have some time so I'm good.
Besides, I'm not sure if I wanna go...
There's someone I really admired. I don't wanna see them look old.
Oh dear, but doesn't that kind of apply to you too?
Truuue. How could you say that when you aged just as much?
No one's gonna be shocked by my change.
Maybe you were strangely popular.
That's a pretty nice thing to say...!
Although "strangely" kinda bothers me.
So, you gonna go or what?
Well, a part of me does want to go, I guess.
It's just a conflict between my memories and reality...
What the hell are you talking about?
Aren't you 30 this year? They should still be young, then.
That's still really young.
Making yourself feel better, Mama?
Eh?
Y-You don't understand. They're not youthful anymore...
How would you know?
Because... the person I admired was my homeroom teacher!
Ohhh, that's who it is.
Well, how do I put this...?
An adult with a lot of experience isn't so bad.
Hm? What's going on?
Oh sorry, I dozed off for a bit...
You should really lend him an ear.
You know, a baseball player married his friend's mom last year.
Oh, that should give you hope, Akiyoshi-kun!
Eh? How so?
What's important between a man and a woman is their feelings.
Haven't I always told you not to be worried about age or looks?
You haven't... How is any of this even relevant?
He's saying age shouldn't matter!
All right! A toast to Akiyoshi-kun's future prospects!
Oh, should we open a new sochu!?
You all just want a reason to drink.
Anyway, you don't want to see your beloved teacher all aged up, right?
Well, to put it bluntly, yeah...
Go see them, Akiyoshi-san!
All in all, you guys will reminisce and get along in no time.
Is that how it usually goes? Was I getting worked up for nothing?
Okay, I decided! I'll attend the class reunion!
Sounds like you made up your mind.
So are you gonna keep your guard up from now on, Mama?
Me? How come?
If he gets closer to his teacher, he might stop coming here.
That makes no sense! What are you talking about!?
Hmm, that would really hurt... my sales.
What? Did you just say it'd hurt "your sales?"
You're imagining things. Here's to Akiyoshi-kun's lovely class reunion...
Cheeeeeers!
I'm going to put a little more thought into this...
You're so indecisive.
I guess that just shows how much he treasures those memories.
Do what you gotta do, but make sure you don't regret it in the end.
Y-You're so right. Haha...
That was a rather dull ending...
What could make ya hate me so much, Gen-san?
Mama, do you know what my hobby is?
Karaoke, right?
Anyone who's ever been to this bar would know that.
He's been practicing his vocal work, too.
Whoa, I didn't know that.
Aren't you glad it's been upgraded?
I splurged on the latest model, y'know. Make sure you sing a lot.
There's no way I can sing on that...
It's way too high-tech for me.
Ah, come to think of it, Gen-san hasn't sung lately.
But didn't you enjoy listening to other people singing?
Well sure, I like listening just as much as I like singing.
The thing sounds great. I can tell it's a great machine.
Then sing already. Why waste those lungs?
Relax, Mama.
There's no way I could use such a fancy machine.
It's even got a remote control with a screen on it...
That's what makes it useful!
It's easier to choose a song.
Yeah, but...
Wait, have you not even sung on the new machine once yet?
That's right. The shower is my only concert venue now.
That so...?
I can't believe your complaint is that I got a better machine.
What do you think, Kiryu-san?
Why don't you try singing on it once?
Yeah, you've never even tried.
Huh? Kiryu-san, were you even paying attention?
Oh, sorry... What were we talking about?
Gen-san's hating on the new machine without trying it.
I just really dislike newfangled gadgets.
I only just started learning how to use cordless phones...
Gen-san, did you time travel from the past or something?
Geez! I only bought it because I thought you'd use it.
Now I'm gonna be in the red!
Ah, I figured money was your aim.
Hey, it's still a business after all.
Sheesh, I don't like depending on machines for everything.
It's just asking for humanity to be taken over by a robot uprising.
The previous karaoke was a machine too...
Now now, let's calm down, Gen-san.
Yeah, machines just take getting used to. Right?
Machines can be handy once you actually start using them.
Yup, I agree.
S-Sorry, I was thinking about something else...
Even though it's new, I was surprised by it suddenly showing up.
So stay current. You got used to it right away, right?
Yeah, I get pretty worked up trying to get my ranking up.
You know this bar doesn't have a whole lot of customers.
Shut up.
Not the bar's ranking. The national ranking!
National?
That machine instantly ranks you against others in the country.
Even though the bar is small, I can sing against lots of people.
Do you guys have a problem with my bar's size...?
